blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts. Its deployable prediction is a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging, while a harm penalty discourages extra loss on points that the mean already classifies correctly. A matched component study shows why each design choice is needed: an unconstrained learned mixture loses 1.032 mIoU points relative to probability mean, harm regularization restores 0.359 points at fixed capacity, and removing an unnecessary point-wise gate slightly improves accuracy and stability. With three zones for fitting, two disjoint zones for residual-strength selection, and router-untouched t5b5 for final reporting, CableMoE obtains 84.906% mIoU and 98.140 % overall accuracy. This is +10.000 points over SPT and +0.263 over probability mean; all three seeds improve the latter. Across pylon, conductor, structural-cable, and insulator classes, macro-IoU rises from 84.517% for SPT and 97.153% for probability mean to 98.144 %. The results support conservative residual composition, not a claim of a new segmentation backbone or universal state of the art
blocks.zh: 对传输走廊进行语义制图,得益于各种LiDAR和图像制导的预测器,但用学习的路由器取代一个强大的组合可能会损害稀有的电气资产。 我们介绍CableMoE, 后热混合 四个冷冻分解专家。 其可部署预测是围绕可获取性-可知概率平均值进行校准的剩余值,而伤害处罚则避免因平均值已经正确分类而造成额外损失。 一个匹配的组件研究显示为什么需要每个设计选择:一个不受约束的学习混合物相对于概率平均值损失了1.032 mIoU点,伤害规范化恢复了固定容量的0.359点,以及移除一个不必要的点位门略微提高了精度和稳定性. CableMoE有3个装配区、2个余力选择区和路由器未触碰的t5b5装配区,获得84.906%的MIOU和98.140%的总准确度。 这比小组委员会多出1万分,比概率平均值多出0.263分;这三种种子都改善了后者。 在整个管线、导线、结构可控和绝缘类中,大型IoU从小组委员会的84.517%和概率的97.53%上升到98.144%。 结果支持保守的残余成分,而不是声称有新的分化骨干或普遍技术水平

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Reliable inspection planning begins with a reliable inventory of the corridor.
Airborne mapping can provide this inventory at scale, but its semantic map must
retain thin, sparsely sampled conductors, structural cables, pylons, and
insulators while separating them from dominant vegetation and terrain. LiDAR
captures geometry reliably, whereas registered imagery can resolve appearance
ambiguities; imagery, however, may be occluded or unavailable outside the
camera footprint. The resulting problem is therefore both class-imbalanced and
sensor-dependent.

in which every LiDAR point receives an infrastructure or context label.

LiDAR, imagery, eleven grouped classes, and heterogeneous frozen predictions [ 2 ] . Its asset and context classes differ sharply in

The available experts reflect successive advances in 3-D understanding, from
hierarchical point sets [ 3 ] , deformable point convolutions [ 4 ] , and sparse voxel–point processing [ 5 ] to SPT’s hierarchical superpoints [ 6 ] and PTv3’s serialized point attention [ 7 ] . Image voting and late fusion add complementary appearance
evidence. Yet no expert dominates every class or location: their failures are
complementary, their confidence scales are not directly comparable, and errors
on rare electrical assets can disappear inside overall accuracy.

blocks.en:
This complementarity changes the research question. The immediate need is not
another segmentation backbone, but a dependable way to compose already-trained
experts. A simple probability mean is a surprisingly strong control—in our
geographic evaluation it exceeds SPT by 9.737 mIoU points. Directly replacing
that mean with a learned router can therefore destroy useful consensus while
trying to exploit expert specialization. A learned composer should instead
justify and limit every departure from the strong average.

blocks.en:
We address this requirement with CableMoE, a deliberately post-hoc mean-residual mixture of four frozen experts. Availability-aware
probability mean remains inside the deployment rule; a small router proposes
only a convex direction of change. A scalar selected exclusively on calibration
zones limits the residual strength, while a harm term penalizes changes that
corrupt points already classified correctly by the mean. Freezing every expert
isolates the value of composition from backbone retraining and permits an exact,
source-order-preserving implementation.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: • a probability-mean-contained convex MoE that combines availability
masking with an explicit penalty for harming a strong ensemble baseline; • an exact-identity implementation that preserves source-LAS order while
composing frozen LiDAR and image-guided predictions; • a disjoint three-zone fit, two-zone calibration, and router-untouched
geographic evaluation with three seeds; and • a matched component study that separates probability containment and
harm regularization, rejects an unsupported point-wise gate, and reports
asset-specific behavior.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Transmission-corridor segmentation. GridNet-HD supplies aligned airborne LiDAR, oblique imagery, eleven grouped
classes, and frozen baseline outputs [ 2 ] . TS40K,
ECLAIR, and TowerDataset provide related rural, aerial, and long-corridor
benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , but
their taxonomies and protocols differ. Recent corridor methods emphasize
critical regions [ 11 ] , point attention [ 12 , 13 ] , graph context [ 14 ] ,
elevation [ 15 ] , geometry [ 16 ] , and class
imbalance [ 17 ] . DITR transfers 2-D foundation features
into 3-D [ 18 ] , while DeepChoice learns image-view
weighting [ 19 ] . More general multimodal segmentation
either performs bidirectional 2-D/3-D projection [ 20 ] or distills
image priors into a LiDAR-only model [ 21 ] . Local neighborhood pooling provides a
complementary way to aggregate texture and context in remote-sensing imagery [ 22 ] , while traffic-aware intention prediction demonstrates
context-conditioned graph reasoning in a different spatiotemporal setting [ 23 ] . These methods train representations or task-specific
predictors; we instead compose already-trained heterogeneous segmenters.

blocks.en:
Thin electrical assets also connect this problem to category-specific remote
sensing fusion [ 24 ] , spectral point representations [ 25 ] , topology-preserving objectives for tubular
structures [ 26 ] , and dedicated airborne-laser power-line
extraction [ 27 ] . An end-to-end phenotyping pipeline further
illustrates how image extraction, analysis, and evaluation can be designed as
one reproducible scientific workflow [ 28 ] . These ideas are
complementary to our study:
they can improve an individual expert or impose a structural prior, whereas
our controlled question is whether frozen, heterogeneous experts can be
composed without sacrificing a strong probability-average baseline.

blocks.en:
Expert composition and conservative prediction. Stacked generalization and dynamic classifier selection combine diverse
predictors [ 29 , 30 ] . Mixture-of-experts and
learning-to-defer methods further learn which predictor to trust [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] .
Deep ensembles show that averaging independently trained predictors can
improve accuracy and uncertainty quality [ 35 ] ; our
probability mean differs only in that its members are heterogeneous frozen
architectures. Selective prediction
often trades accuracy against coverage [ 36 ] , whereas
our output is always a dense semantic label. Calibration remains difficult for
imbalanced segmentation [ 37 ] ; therefore, we do not treat
raw confidence as a risk guarantee. Our narrower contribution is baseline
containment: learning only a calibrated residual around probability mean and
penalizing loss increases on mean-correct points.

Related 3-D reconstruction studies use local/global wavelet regularization to
stabilize sparse-view Gaussian splatting [ 38 ] and
motion-regime experts to specialize dynamic Gaussian predictors [ 39 ] . Those methods optimize scene representations or
motion-specific predictors; in contrast, CableMoE performs post-hoc composition
of frozen semantic segmenters while retaining a strong ensemble baseline.

blocks.en: III-D Matched component variants
blocks.zh: 相匹配的组件变体

blocks.en:
We test four trainable variants under identical zones, features, seeds, and
optimization. Pure learned MoE uses 𝒒 \boldsymbol{q} directly and removes both
harm and distillation. No harm retains the learned gate and distillation
but sets the harm weight to zero. Harm + gate is the earlier full
parameterization. Final harm, no gate uses Eqs. ( 3 )–
( 4 ). Probability mean is a deterministic, no-training control.
Thus the comparisons isolate whether mean containment, harm regularization,
and gating are supported by held-out geography.

但将伤害重设为零。 伤害+门是较早的全能

因此,比较将是否意味着遏制、损害规范化,
和地理学的支持。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 四. 实验议定书

blocks.en: IV-A Data roles and training
blocks.zh: 数据作用和培训

blocks.en:
GridNet-HD has eleven grouped classes. The released SPT, PTv3, ImageVote, and
LateFusion probabilities are stored in float16 and converted to normalized
float32 distributions before composition. The six labeled public zones belong
to the benchmark’s official validation release and are excluded from expert
training, although aggregate validation performance may have influenced
released checkpoint selection. We therefore claim router-untouched evaluation,
not a completely unseen expert domain.

GridNet-HD有11个分组类. 释放的小组委员会,PTv3,ImageVote,
延迟合并概率被存储在浮点16并转换为正态
组成前为浮32分布. 6个标注的公共区属于
基准正式验证的释放,不包括专家
培训,尽管总体审定绩效可能影响
发布检查点选择。 因此,我们声称路由器未触碰评估,
不是完全看不见的专家领域。

blocks.en:
The geographic protocol assigns t1z5b, t4z1, and t5b1 to router fitting;
t1z8 and t3z4 to hyperparameter calibration; and t5b5 to final evaluation.
Deterministic source-ordinal hashing retains 423,231 disagreement-focused fit
samples and 396,178 calibration candidates. No t5b5 label selects a weight,
seed, or residual strength. The evaluation contains 61,412,436 points and ten
present classes; water is absent and is omitted rather than assigned zero IoU.

t1z8和t3z4为高参数校正;t5b5为最终评价.

All variants use AdamW for 15 epochs, batch size 32,768, learning rate 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , and gradient norm 5. Three

end-to-end latency includes four expert inferences and is not measured.

blocks.en: IV-B Metrics and claim boundary
blocks.zh: 四-B 计量和索赔边界

blocks.en:
Primary metric is ground-truth-present mIoU; overall accuracy (OA) and
per-class IoU are secondary. Mean and population standard deviation summarize
three router fits on the same evaluation population; they measure fitting
stability, not geographic confidence. Comparisons to methods trained with
different data or preprocessing are contextual. We make no state-of-the-art,
formal risk-control, fault-detection, clearance, or broad-domain claim.

主要衡量标准是地面实况-mIoU;总体准确性(OA)和
每级IoU为二级. 平均和人口标准差汇总
3个路由器符合同一评价群;它们衡量是否合适
稳定,而不是地理上的信任。 与培训方法的比较
不同的数据或预处理是上下文的。 我们没有做最先进的,
正式的风险控制、过失发现、清理或广域索赔。

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Why the result is useful. The experiment shows that most performance comes from heterogeneous expert
composition, not a deeper router. The final contribution is a conservative way
to learn on top of that strong composition: retain probability mean in the
policy, penalize mean-correct damage, and select only one residual-strength
scalar outside the evaluation zone. This is directly relevant to corridor
mapping because the four electrical-asset classes improve strongly over the
single LiDAR anchor. The output remains a semantic inventory layer; geometric
clearance and condition assessment require separately validated geometry and
topology.
blocks.zh:
为什么结果有用。 实验显示 大部分表现来自不同的专家
组成,不是更深的路由器。 最后的贡献是保守的
在强构成的基础上学习:
政策,惩罚平均正确损害,只选择一个剩余力量
评估区外的斯卡尔. 这与走廊直接相关
由于四个电动资产类别比
单 LiDAR 主播. 输出仍为语义盘点层;几何
清除和状况评估需要分别验证几何和
地貌学.

blocks.en:
Why a residual rather than direct replacement. A conventional gate is free to replace the ensemble distribution everywhere,
including regions where averaging already suppresses an expert-specific
mistake. Equation ( 3 ) instead separates two roles: the mean is
the always-present reference and the router estimates only a direction of
change. The scalar α \alpha then limits how far deployment can move along that
direction. This is not a formal safety bound, but it makes the intervention
strength observable and testable; Fig. 3 (a) empirically confirms
that unconstrained replacement is the weakest matched trainable variant.
blocks.zh:
为什么是剩余而不是直接替换。 一个常规的门是免费的 取代综艺的分布,
包括平均已抑制特定专家
错误。 方程式(3)将两个角色分开:
和路由器只估计
变化。 星标 α-α 限制部署能走多远
向上转 这不是一个正式的安全约束,但它使得干预
图3(a)
不受约束的替换是最弱的可训练变体

blocks.en:
Limitations. All six public zones come from one benchmark release, and three seeds do not
measure geographic uncertainty. t5b5 is untouched by the router protocol but
is not an expert-level external dataset. The gain over probability mean is
small, and three context classes regress. No matched official hidden score is
available for this final no-gate model; an older hard-selector leaderboard
result is intentionally excluded because it evaluates a different policy.
Four frozen experts are also more expensive than a single backbone. The
post-hoc mixer is inexpensive, but end-to-end expert latency, energy, and
sensor shift remain unmeasured. The outage stress test shows that availability
masking alone is insufficient for LateFusion loss and LiDAR-only operation;
expert-dropout training requires evaluation on a new untouched zone.
The harm loss is an empirical regularizer, not a conformal or probabilistic
risk guarantee.
blocks.zh:
限制。 所有六个公共区都来自一个基准区,三个种子没有
测量地理不确定性。 t5b5不受路由器协议的影响,但
不是一个专家级的外部数据集。 胜于概率的增益是
小, 三上下文类递减 。 没有匹配的官方隐藏分数
可用于此最终无门模式; 更古老的硬选取主板
故意排除结果,因为它评价的是不同的政策。
4名被冻结的专家也比一个骨干要贵. 这个
热量后搅拌机价格低廉,但端到端的专家耐久性、能耗和
传感器的移位仍未计量。 断气压力测试显示,可用性
仅遮盖不足以用于LateFusion损失和只用于LiDAR操作;
专家辍学培训需要对一个新的未受影响的区域进行评价。
损害损失是一种经验性的常态化剂,而不是符合性或概率的
风险保障。

blocks.en:
Reproducibility. The final expert order is SPT/PTv3/ImageVote/LateFusion. Zone roles, source
ordinals, availability masks, class mapping, three seeds, and calibration grid
are fixed before evaluation. The calibration-selected deployment checkpoint is
seed 20261107 with α = 0.75 \alpha=0.75 ; the three-seed table, rather than this single
checkpoint, supports the reported stability. All metrics are recomputed from
raw-order predictions, and absent classes are recorded explicitly.

发相相. 最后的专家命令是小组委员会/PTv3/ImageVote/LateFusion。 区域角色,来源
平面、可用口罩、分级绘图、三颗种子和校准网格
在评价前固定。 校正-选定部署检查站

检查站,支持报告的稳定。 所有度量衡都从
生序预测和缺课都有明确的记录。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
CableMoE composes four frozen transmission-corridor segmenters using a
harm-regularized convex residual around probability mean. A matched ablation
shows that baseline containment and the harm term are useful, while a learned
point-wise gate is not. On router-untouched t5b5, the final no-gate model obtains 84.906 ± 0.099 84.906\pm 0.099 % mIoU and 98.140 ± 0.008 98.140\pm 0.008 % OA, improving SPT by 10.000
points and the strong probability mean by 0.263. The method is therefore best
viewed as a conservative expert-composition pipeline, not a new backbone or a
universal risk-control mechanism. A matched hidden evaluation and additional
geographies are the highest-value next tests.
